title: MNI Open iEEG Atlas: high-sampling-rate NREM sleep sEEG (normal high-frequency oscillations)
description: Stereo-EEG recordings of non-REM (N2/N3) sleep at original sampling rates (512, 1024 and 2000 Hz) from 71 patients with drug-resistant focal epilepsy, released through the MNI Open iEEG Atlas. Only bipolar channels judged to show normal physiological activity in non-lesional grey matter are included (1152 channels), with Talairach coordinates and 17 brain-region labels. The data were used to derive normative values for ripples, fast ripples and high-frequency activity across brain regions.
methods_description: Clinical stereo-EEG depth recordings (DIXI or MNI homemade electrodes) from three tertiary epilepsy centres, stored as bipolar derivations between adjacent contacts. Twenty-minute N2/N3 sleep sections were selected for HFO analysis. Source int16 data were repacked losslessly into BrainVision format with resolution set to the source gain. Channel positions are the midpoints of the bipolar contact pairs in Talairach space.
